## zipzi.Session

`(factory-owned; use the documented public entry)`

One client binding to a resident document. Use runtime.sessions factories; aliases share detach/close state. id is pure cached identity, while info queries host state.


## zipzi.Session.address

`(selector: modeling.AddressSelector) -> references.FieldAddress`

Capture a field address with incarnation, context and field epochs. The returned handle owns a lease and must be closed; recreated IDs cannot revive an old address.


## zipzi.Session.bindings

`(session: '_lifecycle.Session', edit: '_lifecycle.Edit | None'=None)`

Immutable typed value. See field semantics and the linked workflow.


## zipzi.Session.bindings.get

`(id: str, *, expected: Source | None=None) -> Snapshot[bindings.MeshBinding]`

Read one owned value at an exact source. Missing IDs fail the whole read; recover the original call after transport loss.


## zipzi.Session.bindings.get_many

`(ids: Sequence[str], *, expected: Source | None=None) -> Batch[bindings.MeshBinding]`

Read all IDs in request order, including duplicates. Empty batches keep Source; missing IDs or budgets reject the entire read.


## zipzi.Session.bindings.list

`(*, name: str | None=None, limit: int=128, cursor: PageCursor | None=None) -> Page[bindings.Summary]`

Read bounded metadata in SDK storage order. Names match exactly and preserve duplicates. Source changes raise STALE_SOURCE; restart explicitly.


## zipzi.Session.capabilities

`(query: modeling.CollectionQuery) -> Snapshot[modeling.Capabilities]`

Query selected collection capabilities at the captured formal Source. Results explain available/unavailable/unsupported states and do not reserve future admission.


## zipzi.Session.close

`(*, discard_modified: bool=False) -> SessionInfo`

Close the host session and release its path/slot. Unsaved changes and other clients refuse closure without changes. Never saves implicitly.


## zipzi.Session.detach

`() -> None`

Release this client's binding and its references. Active work refuses detach; the host session remains resident. Aliases become invalid.


## zipzi.Session.edit

`(label: str) -> 'Edit'`

Begin an explicit candidate with a history label. Reads see candidate changes; normal context exit commits and waits. Confirmed write failures require a new Edit and unknown outcomes require original-call recovery.


## zipzi.Session.editor_context

`() -> Snapshot[modeling.EditorContext | None]`

Read an owned optional Editor context and exact formal Source. Local or non-Editor hosts can return None; no Editor object is exposed.


## zipzi.Session.id

`() -> SessionId`

Return cached Runtime-scoped identity without IO. Persistent object IDs belong to this session and do not substitute for a SessionId.


## zipzi.Session.info

`() -> SessionInfo`

Read current version, modified state, history lengths, path and host state. Returns an owned value; a lost response recovers the original query.

## zipzi.Session.plan

`(operation: ops.PlannableOperation) -> plans.Plan`

Plan a registered typed domain operation against the exact formal Source. Read cost/losses, apply through an Edit, then close the Plan. Planning failures do not abort another candidate.


## zipzi.Session.plan_async

`(operation: ModelingPlanOperation) -> Job[plans.Plan]`

Submit a registered expensive modeling plan at the captured Source. Returns Job[Plan]; wait before applying and close the resulting Plan. Input type determines this explicit Job API.


## zipzi.Session.project

`(session: Session)`

Host-side format and persistence operations. Every path is absolute on the selected execution host; IO returns explicit Jobs.


## zipzi.Session.project.diagnose

`() -> Job[modeling.ProjectReport]`

Submit SDK project diagnostics without publishing edited model content. Returns Job[ProjectReport] with owned diagnostics; wait releases the result slot.


## zipzi.Session.project.export

`(path: Path, format: modeling.ExportFormat, *, name: str='model', object_id: str | None=None, allow_loss: bool=False, bake_animation: bool=False, auto_frame_rate: bool=False) -> Job[modeling.ProjectReport]`

Submit a selected export to a host-absolute path. allow_loss, animation baking and frame-rate choices are explicit. Read report losses/published and wait for the durable IO outcome.


## zipzi.Session.project.open

`(path: Path) -> Job[modeling.ProjectReport]`

Replace this session from an absolute host project path through an explicit Job. Successful replacement advances generation and invalidates old source-bound addresses/plans.


## zipzi.Session.project.replace

`(path: Path, format: modeling.ImportFormat, *, textures: tuple[modeling.TextureSlot, ...]=()) -> Job[modeling.ProjectReport]`

Submit explicit format import to replace this session. Textures are host-absolute slots. Wait for the real report; generation changes only after confirmed publication.


## zipzi.Session.project.run

`(request: modeling.ProjectRequest) -> Job[modeling.ProjectReport]`

Submit one typed ProjectRequest and return Job[ProjectReport]. Input selects explicit format/IO policy; losses and notices belong to the report. Wait and verify before claiming publication.


## zipzi.Session.project.save

`(path: Path) -> Job[SaveReceipt]`

Submit saving to a host-absolute project folder. Returns Job[SaveReceipt]; wait checks durable and before/after versions. A client-side Path.exists is not evidence of host persistence.


## zipzi.Session.redo

`() -> Job[Receipt]`

Submit one formal history redo and return Job[Receipt]. Wait for the actual receipt. Cancelling or a no-op Edit preserves redo according to SDK history rules.


## zipzi.Session.reference

`(kind: references.ObjectKind, id: str) -> references.ObjectRef`

Capture an SDK object reference for the declared kind and canonical UUID. Runtime validates session ownership and incarnation. Close the returned reference after use.

## zipzi.describe

`(path: str) -> ApiDescription`

Look up an exact public path, e.g. Session.meshes.list, without IO or eval.

Unknown paths raise KeyError. Short paths are normalized under zipzi.
The root description links the bundled short guide and executable recipes.
This describes the installed API, while runtime.capabilities() describes
the connected host. No resource is constructed or RPC sent by this query.

id: Persistent canonical UUID in the selected document.

runtime_id: SDK runtime label; empty when this kind has no runtime label.
part_id: Owning Part UUID when applicable; None means no Part ownership.
parent_id: Deformation or organization parent UUID when applicable.
enabled: Whether the scene object is enabled; true for metadata without that field.
mesh_id: Bound mesh UUID for mesh bindings; None for other collections.
width: Decoded image width in pixels when known, without reading pixels.
height: Decoded image height in pixels when known, without reading pixels.
vertex_count: Number of mesh vertices, without cloning vertex data.

- `id`: Persistent canonical UUID in the selected document.

## zipzi.recover_call

`(method: Callable[P, U], /, *args: P.args, **kwargs: P.kwargs) -> U`

Call a registered SDK request method once and recover its Call once.

Parameters exactly match the bound SDK method, preserving its return type.
Arbitrary functions, lambdas and unregistered wrappers raise TypeError before
execution. Busy, ordinary failures, budgets and JobTimeout are propagated.
If recovery is still unknown, retain that exception and its owner to resume
later; this helper never replays a user function or loops on recovery.
